The strategy says 'Start Death Star and whatever interrupt is necesary' – the cards named (Secret Plans, Bad Feeling Have I, Crush The Rebellion, Security Precautions) are Effects and vary by opponent, so only Death Star is set as the starting location.
Posted 'Hoth5th marker' dested Hoth: Ice Plains (5th Marker); 'Hoth7th marker' Hoth: Wampa Cave (7th Marker); 'ExecutorMed Chamber' Executor: Meditation Chamber; 'DagCave' Dagobah: Cave.

Posted 'Vader w/' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'IG 88 w/' IG-88 With Riot Gun; '2x Mara Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Septoid droid' WED15-l7 'Septoid' Droid; 'Boba Fett in' / 'Zuckuss in' the pilot-in-ship cards.
Posted '3x Evader' dested the A New Hope interrupt Evader (Evader & Monnok is Reflections II, Dec 2000); '3x Twi Lek' Twi'lek Advisor; 'Comer Here You Big Coward' Come Here You Big Coward.
